scope: CPU / rendering submission optimization; no memory resource lifecycle changes; Android emulator Web preview, not TapTap phone acceptance.

retained.change: At full opacity, append lag/current rectangles to the existing per-bar background Graphics. Keep original per-bar/name order, semantic colors, dimensions and original Sprite fills for lethal fade. Retessellate only when fractions/mode change, once per bar/frame.
retained.draws: 20 visible bars + names: 60 -> 40; native fade still 60. No shared global reordering or label cache/font changes.

retained.change: Two adjacent stationary minimap reserved rims share one Graphics. Keep original slot nodes, positions, sizes and interaction/layout metadata. Interactive button faces retain original independent press transforms.
retained.draws: Visible minimap HUD frozen fixture: 78 -> 77; triangles unchanged. Training HUD hides minimap, so this gain is outside the training benchmark.

notRetained.candidate: Merge minimap static terrain and exploration fog
notRetained.reason: One fewer draw, but exploration would retessellate previously static terrain. Retained original independent terrain/fog cache.

Not enabled: installed Cocos 3.8.8 legacy forward pipeline collects instanced passes in a separate queue and records it before ordinary transparent queue. Enabling instancing would bypass existing interleaved transparent model order, affecting overlapping monsters / hero / effects. Per-actor UV, tint and transparency remain intact.

fixture.skills: BOW slots0 and1 at seconds1 and3 of each6-second wave; basic attack holds at0-.5,2-2.5,4-4.5

protocol.measurement: Native Android Chrome process /proc CPU; 100% = one logical core, normalized over 4 cores. CDP threadTicks main-thread TaskDuration / actual rendered frames. No profiler, screenshot, GPU query, forcedGC or Creator build inside either measurement window.

coverage.equal: 20 live slots, 220 hits, 40 skill releases, 60 projectiles, 20 wave resets, no dead frames. Small movement-clock/actual frame count differences recorded in raw reports.

visualValidation.result: Full, loss/lag, empty, partial-opacity fade and overlapping bars/names: exact pixels in bar region. UI camera only frozen fixture, not a full-scene bitwise acceptance.
visualValidation.minimapResult: Initial, explored, rotated and pressed states: identical slot positions/radii/interaction flags, same triangles, one fewer draw. Full-frame raster differences <=4/255 channel levels, mean absolute channel delta <0.00042; inspected thumbnail differences, no visible layout/control change.
